title: Cheese Chicken
reject_reason: Chicken smothered in a broccoli-cheddar cheese sauce is the same dinner as live chicken-divan-broccoli-bake (chicken + broccoli + cheddar cheese); only skillet-vs-bake format differs, which does not distinguish the plate.
